---
name: customer-signal-synthesis
description: Turn support conversations, interviews, feedback, churn reasons, and observed behavior into evidence-backed product signals without overreacting to anecdotes.
---

# Customer Signal Synthesis

Aggregate customer evidence by underlying job/problem rather than requested feature wording.

Separate:
- repeated observed problem
- explicit feature request
- confusion caused by UX/copy
- bug/reliability issue
- missing capability
- edge case
- praise with no behavior change

Preserve source references and frequency where available. Note customer segment and context so one power user does not silently become the whole market.

Look for convergence across support, interviews, usage behavior, and churn. Distinguish frequency from severity.

## Output

Return the strongest signals, contradictory evidence, candidate root cause, smallest experiment/change, and what additional evidence would materially change the conclusion. Do not convert every request into backlog work.
